items.name: Empire State Winter Whirl 2023
items.information: This is a series competition with [Empire State Winter Warmup 2023](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterWarmup2023), which will have a more traditional competition experience. We highly recommend that newer competitors and/or competitors who only want to compete in a few events register for that one instead. You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Winter Warmup 2023, your registration for this competition will be rejected. All competitors must read the COVID Safety tab before registering, as proof of full vaccination or a negative test will be required.

items.name: Franconia Mini Open B 2023
items.information: Franconia Mini Open B 2023 is open to every citizen from every nation. Franconia Mini Open B 2023 is a one-day competition and series competition to Franconia Mini Open A 2023, which will be held one day earlier. Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration. Franconia Mini Open B 2023 ist eine Ein-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von Franconia Mini Open A 2023, die einen Tag früher stattfinden wird. Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen.

items.information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. Please note that this is a **Side Events** competition. This means that 3x3 speedsolving **will NOT** be held at this competition. If you are looking to compete in events that are not being held, please look for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?event_ids%5B%5D=333&region=_North+America&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). **Please note that advancement conditions for final rounds may change, depending on registration numbers.** Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 1 guest. Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule as the day progresses, so **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time.
